description: Sugar Cookie Recipe: • 2 cups white sugar • 1½ cups softened butter • 4 large eggs • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract • 5 cups flour • 2 teaspoons baking powder • 1 teaspoon salt 1. Beat sugar and softened butter together until smooth. 2. Beat in eggs and vanilla. 3. Stir in flour, baking powder, and salt. Cover, and refrigerate dough for at least 1 hour. 4. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Lightly dust counter with flour. Roll out dough to 1/4 inch thickness. 5. Cut into shapes and place cookies 1 inch apart on baking sheets. 6. Bake in the preheated oven for 6-7 minutes. 7. Allow to cool completely before decorating. Enjoy! #sugarcookies #sugarcookierecipe #christmascookies #25daysofchristmas #christmasbaking
transcript: Day two of 25 days of Christmas cookies and today we are sticking with another classic, the sugar cookies. I feel like these are so intimidating, but I promise you they are super easy. And the key is to take them out of the oven before they even show signs of being done because they do bake pretty quickly. Mine only spends six minutes in the oven. I will have all the exact measurements in the caption. These are so fun to decorate. I usually just bake a ton of them and then invite my friends over and we have a little cookie decorating party. These are so easy and delicious. Make sure to come back tomorrow for day three.
